Question 1
?

For which of the following vector fields is f(x,y)=yexy a potential function?

a
(y+1)exyi+xexyj
b
y2exyi+(xy+1)exyj
c
xyexyi+(x+1)exyj
d
y2exyi+x2exyj
e
yexyi+xyexyj
